title: Exact quotient-cell partition of the frozen Barrett implementation

properties.claim: The magic-multiply quotient equals the quotient derived from an independent centered-modulo oracle for every int16_t input.
The production return value equals a minus 3329 times the characterized quotient.
The quotient is always between -10 and 10 inclusive.
Every input belongs to the exact cell of its quotient and no other valid quotient cell.
The two clipped endpoint cells and nineteen complete interior cells have the exact declared boundaries.

input_domain.candidate_cell_k: all int32_t values, with valid-cell condition encoded as a logical implication

novelty_classification: Implementation-specific structural CBMC theorem; mathematical world-first not claimed.
portability_scope: Arithmetic right shift follows the semantics represented by the recorded CBMC environment.
